Weak liquidity (current ratio 0.79) and a very low EBIT-to-assets ratio imply limited near-term financial flexibility, while liabilities are high relative to equity despite a still-positive equity base and retained earnings. Positive operating income and substantial shareholder equity support credit quality above deep-speculative levels, but the balance sheet and coverage profile look more consistent with non-investment-grade risk.

DECISION: BB-
